name: chzzk-chat-collector
description: 치지직 실시간 채팅 수집기 - 스트리머 이름 검색 및 자동 방송 감지

scripts.build: npm run build:bundle && npm run build:exe && npm run build:sign-mac
scripts.build:win-x64: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --public --public-packages "*" --targets node18-win-x64 -o dist/chzzk-chat-collector
scripts.build:win-arm64: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --public --public-packages "*" --targets node18-win-arm64 -o dist/chzzk-chat-collector
scripts.build:mac-x64: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --public --public-packages "*" --targets node18-macos-x64 -o dist/chzzk-chat-collector
scripts.build:mac-arm64: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --public --public-packages "*" --targets node18-macos-arm64 -o dist/chzzk-chat-collector
scripts.build:linux-x64: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --public --public-packages "*" --targets node18-linux-x64 -o dist/chzzk-chat-collector
scripts.build:linux-arm64: npm run build:bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --public --public-packages "*" --targets node18-linux-arm64 -o dist/chzzk-chat-collector
